note: 可复用的归档规格：共同约束加各场景描述；实际逐张调用有同义措辞和光影细节调整。
common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square full-bleed StarLock CAPTCHA source illustration. Reference identity: rounded lilac/purple padlock, arched shackle and FOUR-point-star negative-space keyhole. Premium tactile 3D/editorial art direction, asymmetric composition, crafted material detail and soft cinematic lighting. Keep the primary lock within central 85% for a circular crop. Distinct irregular visual contours should cross the middle 40–75% diameter region and remain recognizable at 256px. No text, letters, numbers, UI, watermark, border, circular frame, seams, actual puzzle cutouts, five-point stars, radial symmetry or new mascot.
